claude_only.name: Which system is the authoritative master for this record's identifier and from which registered scheme is the value drawn?
Does the identifier denote the record, one version, or one instantiation?
What guarantees that the identifier is never reused after disposition or system migration?
Which legacy or alternate identifiers exist and on what basis are they asserted equivalent?
What is the official title of the record, in which language and script is it recorded, and who set it?
Which reference numbers appear on the face of the record and which authority allocated each?
How are superseded or translated titles retained without ever being treated as identifiers?
What documentary form does this record take and from which controlled vocabulary is the term drawn?
Which obligations, signature requirements or retention consequences follow automatically from that form?
Can one record carry more than one documentary form, such as a certificate inside a covering letter?
Who approves additions to the form vocabulary and how are retired terms handled?
Under which classification class is the record filed and which version of the scheme was in force at filing?
Which aggregations does the record belong to and is membership exclusive?
When the scheme is reorganised, is the historic class retained alongside the new one?
If more than one class applies, which one determines retention and access?
Which components make up the complete record and which of them are essential rather than incidental?
Which significant properties must be preserved for the record to remain usable and understandable?
In which languages is the content expressed and which language version is authoritative for interpretation?
How is completeness verified before the record is declared captured?
Which event fixes a version and makes it immutable, and who is competent to trigger it?
Which version is currently authoritative and which versions does it supersede or amend?
How are drafts distinguished from issued versions for retention and access purposes?
What reason, authority and change description are recorded for each new version?
Which instantiation is the original of record and where is it held?
Is a given instantiation a faithful rendition, a derivative, a certified copy or an extract, and who attests it?
What criteria make a digitised surrogate acceptable in place of an analogue original?
How are two instantiations of the same version proven to carry the same content?
Which registered media type and which format-registry identifier apply to this instantiation?
How was the format determined — declared by the producer or identified by a tool?
What environment is required to render the instantiation faithfully?
What is the obsolescence risk for this format and what migration or emulation path is planned?
Which algorithm and digest value were recorded at capture, and by which agent?
Which preservation actions have been applied and did any of them change the bytes?
What happens when a fixity check fails, and who is notified?
Which agent is the author of record and which agents merely contributed?
Who approved or authorised issue, and under what delegation of authority?
Who are the intended addressees or recipients, and does that constrain access?
How is a role recorded when the responsible agent cannot be identified?
Who owns the record and who currently has custody of it?
What may the custodian not do — can they widen access, migrate formats or dispose?
How and when does ownership itself transfer, and what evidence is required?
Under which mandate, statute or delegated authority was the record issued?
In which jurisdiction and at which place was it issued, and does that determine the applicable rules?
Is the register public, and what is disclosed at existence level when content is withheld?
What signature or seal type was applied and at which assurance tier?
Which exact content does each signature bind — a version, an instantiation, or a byte range?
Who is the signatory or sealing legal person, and on which certificate or credential does the signature rest?
What must hold for the signature to have legal effect in the governing jurisdiction?
Is there a trusted time-stamp token binding the content to a time, and which authority issued it?
What was the validation outcome, at which validation instant, and under which validation policy?
How is the evidence renewed before its algorithms or certificates weaken?
Which provenance manifest, if any, travels with the rendered asset, and does it survive rendition?
Which activity generated this record or version, and when did it start and end?
Which prior records was it derived from, and is the derivation a revision, an extract or a quotation?
Which agent was associated with each generating activity, and on whose behalf did they act?
Where a machine or model produced content, what tool, version and parameters are recorded?
Who held the record over each interval and are there any unexplained gaps?
What receipt or acknowledgement evidences each hand-over?
Was integrity verified at dispatch and again at receipt, and by whom?
How is the chain kept intact when a system migration rewrites storage or re-encodes content?
What is the record's current status and since which instant has it held that status?
Which transitions are permitted from the current status and who may authorise each?
Is withdrawal or revocation distinct from destruction, and does a revoked record remain discoverable?
Which event types are recorded and from which controlled vocabulary are they drawn?
Who performed each event, with what outcome and what detail?
Is the trail append-only and how is its own integrity protected against tampering?
How long is the audit trail retained relative to the record, and does disposition erase it?
Which datetime is the legally or operationally decisive one for this record type?
Over what period is the record valid or effective, and may the period be open-ended?
How are event time and observation or ingestion time kept distinct in every record of time?
How are dates of unknown precision or unknown local offset recorded?
Which retention class applies and under which authority instrument and citation?
What event triggers the retention clock and how is that trigger detected?
Is the record permanent or temporary, and what disposition action falls due at the end of the period?
When two schedules apply to the same record, which one prevails?
What is the scope of the hold — this record, its aggregation, or a query-defined set resolved at a moment in time?
Who placed the hold, under what proceeding or authority, and when?
What must be true before the hold can be released and disposition resumed?
How is hold state surfaced so that no automated process can dispose of a held record?
Who authorised the disposition and was the absence of any hold verified at that moment?
What method was used and is it verifiable as irreversible for the carrier concerned?
What evidence survives destruction and which metadata fields are kept as a tombstone?
For transfer, what accession identifier and integrity proof did the receiving body return?
What security marking and access restriction status does the record carry, and who set them?
Which statutory access or exemption regime applies, and for how long does the restriction run?
What is disclosed at existence level when the content itself is withheld?
How are grants, denials and emergency access events recorded and reviewed?
Who holds rights in the content and under which licence may it be reused?
Does the record contain personal or special-category data, and on what lawful basis is it processed?
What redactions produced the releasable derivative, and is the unredacted source preserved intact?
Which external standards is this metadata mapped to, and at which version of each?
Where does a mapping lose information or contradict another target, and how is the loss recorded?
What evidence supports any conformance claim, and who validated it?
What package structure and manifest are used, and how is package integrity proven on arrival?
Which projection is being served and which fields does it deliberately omit?
How does a receiving system reconstruct identity, version chain, fixity and events from the package alone?
Which media types, character encodings and normalisation rules apply to the payload?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier and its scheme for this object?
Which public IRIs, document numbers, DOI/URN values or Dimension UUID/ULID values also denote this object, and which is correlatable versus display-only?
When was each identifier assigned, and is assignment time distinct from content creation time?
Has this object been captured as a record, and under which jurisdiction or policy is that determination made?
If it is a nonrecord, extra copy or personal file, what is the excluding criterion?
Who has authority to determine record status when systems or staff disagree?
What is the current title, any alternative title, and the type or documentary form of this object?
Which business classification, function or activity class is assigned, and from which scheme version?
What language(s) is the content in, and which subject or coverage terms apply?
What instantiations or renditions currently realize this version, and what is each media type, format registry key, byte size and carrier?
Where is each instantiation located, on what medium, and is that location a content-address, URI, handle or physical place ref?
What representation information or creating application is required to present and interpret this instantiation?
What is the authoritative checksum for each file or bitstream, which algorithm produced it, and who originated it?
What extent (bytes, pages, duration) is declared, and does it match the measured instantiation?
Which version is current for use, and what is its content hash and issued-at time?
What is the ordered version chain, and which relationships are version-of versus format-of?
Is in-place mutation of this version permitted, and if a correction is required what new version is issued?
Which earlier record(s) does this record replace, from when, and is the older identity retained?
Has this record been replaced, and is it still retained under its schedule?
Is the successor a new version of the same identity or a distinct record that replaces this one?
Who signed or sealed which version or instantiation, by what method and at what time?
What is the current validation status, when was it last validated, and against which rules?
Is the evidence an individual signature, an organizational seal, a stamp, or a merely decorative image?
Can this record be shown to be what it purports to be, created or sent by the purported agent at the purported time, and on what evidence?
Has integrity been maintained (complete, unaltered since capture), and what unauthorized change if any was detected?
Can the record still be located, retrieved, presented and interpreted by the intended community?
Is a C2PA or equivalent content-credential manifest present, embedded or as sidecar, and does its hard binding match current bytes?
What origin, action or ingredient assertions does the active manifest claim?
If only a soft binding exists, is it being treated as identity or merely as a lookup hint?
When was the content created, when was it captured as a record, and when was that fact ingested into this system?
Which PREMIS-style or records-process events have occurred, with type, datetime, agent, outcome?
At capture, was a unique identifier assigned and were point-of-capture metadata frozen?
If this object is held in an OAIS-style archive, is the present package a SIP, AIP or DIP, and what is the package identifier?
What migrations or conversions have been performed, from which format to which, with what outcome?
Did ingest mint a new master identifier or preserve the captured record identifier?
Who is the owner or issuing organization, who is the current custodian, and since when?
What custody transfers have occurred, including legal transfer to an archive, and is physical transfer distinct from legal custody?
What parts does this record contain, and of which larger record or record set is it a member?
What other records does it reference, require, or derive from as source?
Which creating activity and creating agent context are asserted, as refs to sibling models rather than inline biographies?
Which disposition authority and schedule item govern this record, and is it GRS-equivalent, agency-approved, or unscheduled?
What trigger starts retention, has the trigger occurred, and what is the resulting eligible-on datetime?
Is the final disposition permanent accession, transfer, destruction, or not yet determined?
Is disposition currently blocked by hold, unscheduled status, incomplete trigger, or missing authority?
If executed, what action, method, actor, datetime, and which instantiations were destroyed versus retained?
Does deletion of this instantiation destroy the record identity, or do other instantiations remain authoritative?
Which holds currently apply, with reason, placer, placed-at, matter ref and scope (content, metadata, copies)?
For each hold, has it been released, by whom, and at what time, and do other holds remain?
If no schedule is approved, is destruction forbidden as if a hold were in place?
What confidentiality or security marking applies, and which access-rule set is in force for content versus metadata?
For a named requester, is read of metadata, rendition, or evidentiary package allowed, denied, or allowed in redacted form, as of when?
What standing exceptions (court order, FOI release, privilege, disability access) modify the default rule?
What is the rights basis (copyright, licence, statute, other), in which jurisdiction, and who is the rights holder?
Which acts are granted or restricted (replicate, migrate, disseminate, extract) and for what term?
Is there a known conflict between a data-subject erasure claim and a records retention duty, and which mandate wins for this object?
Was a certified copy or extract issued, of which version, by whom, to whom, and with what attestation?
Is the certified copy a new instantiation of the same record identity or a new record?
Which uses (view, download, disclose, print) of content or sensitive metadata must be logged, and were they?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
